answers.core: RegEx class is already part of core.
answers.workaround:
I suppose only way to workaround this is using separate regex for each group and apply them sequentially which increase complexity and code size.

I also found #3487 and #2927 where pattern options workaround was suggested, but after reading PCRE2 documentation I didn't found any of such options for this replace options (_UNKNOWN_UNSET and _UNSET_EMPTY).

title: Add option to allow RegEx substitution empty replacement groups
